title: Exam
description: One exam file (schemaVersion 1). An exam is a self-contained bundle of questions. Its 'version' is bumped whenever its content changes.

schemaVersion.description: Content schema contract version. Bump only on breaking changes (see README).

id.description: Stable exam identifier, e.g. 'quran_qalon'. Must match the manifest entry id.

version.description: Exam content version. Incremented on every published change.

language.description: BCP-47 language code of the content.

description.description: Optional short description shown in catalogs.

questions.description: Question list. Question 'id' values must be unique across the whole exam (application-level rule, not expressible in pure JSON Schema).
